Package gui

Class PromotionsController

java.lang.Object
gui.PromotionsController
public class PromotionsController extends Object
controller for the park manager's Promotions panel (PromotionsFrame.fxml).

lets a PARK_MANAGER propose a discount promotion for their assigned park. Promotions are stored as PENDING and only affect pricing once a department manager approves them. The table shows the manager's own park promotions and their current status.
